jobs.title: Certification Program Lead
jobs.description: As Certification Program Lead, you will join the Customer Education and Training team and will take ownership of the strategy, execution, and expansion of our current certification initiatives. Your core mission will be to elevate the Datadog Certified practitioner program into the leading industry credential for individuals and enterprises across observability, security, and the diverse technical ecosystems that Datadog supports. What You'll Do Own program direction, roadmap, and long-term planning. Define growth targets for increasing practitioner and enterprise adoption. Manage the program budget and vendor relationships. Direct the production and publication of new exams, including maintenance and localization of existing content. Partner with engineering and product teams to keep certification criteria accurate as Datadog evolves. Work with Datadog Partner teams on the development and delivery of certification exams for the Datadog Partner Network. Envision, plan, and build promotion and engagement programs to recognize multiple-certified individuals. Empower the sales team to sell certifications to enterprise customers. Collaborate with Customer Education and other teams as they create certification prep workshops and learning resources. Manage a small team of certification coordinators. Who You Are You have 7+ years of experience leading a certification program for developer-focused tools and products. You have managed budgets, vendors, and complex project timelines. You understand the lifecycle of exam development, from role scopes to subject matter expertise to working with psychometric consultants, to publication and localization. You have worked with cloud engineering professionals and understand the professional skills required for devops, software development, and infrastructure monitoring. jobs.title: Field Customer/Tech Training Instructor
jobs.description: Company Overview: Lightspeed is the leading provider of cloud-based software for dealerships, serving the Powersport, Marine, RV, Trailer, and Golf Car industries adding hundreds of dealerships to the Lightspeed community each year. Lightspeed’s Dealer Management Solution (DMS) enables dealerships to optimize their end-to-end business operations, including Sales, Parts, Service, Rentals, Payments, Accounting, and Customer Relationship Management (CRM). When implemented into their daily operations, Lightspeed helps dealers increase their profitability by selling more units, service, and parts, all while creating a more streamlined experience for customers. Lightspeed is the most complete and integrated DMS in the industry with over 500 integrations with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), aftermarket parts and accessory distributors and dozens of other software tools that a dealership may use to run their business. Uniquely designed by dealers for dealers, and refined over the past 4 decades, Lightspeed empowers over 4,500+ dealers across North America with the tools and technology they need to manage their dealerships. The Field Customer/Tech Training Instructor is responsible to work as a key member of the installation team effectively and efficiently and to train all Powersports (Marine, ATV, RV, and Motorcycle) Dealership clients both remotely and on-site. Can be located anywhere in the U.S. near a major airport hub! What you’ll do: Deliver a quality learning experience based on guidelines for the position Consistent and positive client/associate learner interactions.
